name: fengyun_1c_2007
description: Replay of the Chinese anti-satellite test of 2007-01-11: a kinetic kill vehicle on a suborbital trajectory hits the Fengyun-1C weather satellite (~865 km, 98.6 deg) at ~8 km/s. Idealised: Fengyun-1C on a circular orbit with its real inclination and altitude; the interceptor rises steeply from the ground (launched 277 s before impact); masses approximate (Fengyun-1C ~880 kg, interceptor ~600 kg, a public estimate); time of day approximate. The collision is at t = 600 s.
